Q2 — should the Go producer be required to produce a REFUSING artifact it cannot itself check?
Your Q3 ruling has Go construct known-invalid artifacts with predicted refusal sets, and the JS verifier decide them. That tests Go's reading of the spec against JS's implementation of it. It does
test the case I think is most likely to diverge: an artifact Go believes is
